description: SafeShell's only capability grant. §30: 'Tauri capabilities are locked to exactly this command list. The webview has no filesystem or shell API surface enabled at the Tauri configuration level.' No fs/shell/dialog/shell-execute plugin is declared anywhere in this crate — there is nothing broader for this file to accidentally grant. `core:default` covers only window lifecycle and the custom #[tauri::command] surface in `ipc/mod.rs`, which is the entire IPC contract §30/§41 name.
